summary: A 100-foot steel International Derrick tower of unknown build date in Wayne County, documented standing since at least a 1955 photograph.

events.note: Earliest documented trace: a 1955 photograph of the tower held by the Tennessee State Library and Archives
Added to NHLR December 11, 2023, nominated by Jason Johns; register also records a site visit on 2023-11-25 (outcome not stated)

evidence.supports: CCC erected 98 TN lookout towers 1933-1941 (general context, not McGlamery-specific)
evidence.quote: From 1933 to 1941, the Civilian Conservation Corps erected 98 lookout towers in Tennessee.
This tower is an 100ft International Derrick, Model 1933.

evidence.supports: administered by Tennessee Division of Forestry
register records a site visit dated 11/25/23 (no outcome stated)
1955 photograph is the earliest documentary trace found; survey does not name a holding institution

notes_for_editor: Facts are thin: no construction year, staffing history, or access status surfaced within budget. A linked 1955 photo citation (tnsos.org/tsla imagesearch, ImageID=15168) returned HTTP 403 and could not be read; it may be worth a human follow-up for a caption or date. No newspaper or NRHP material found for this specific tower. Fact-check 2026-10-04: removed two overclaims not supported by their cited quotes - the story had attributed the 1955 photo to the Tennessee State Library and Archives (the tnlandforms source only says "1955 photo", with no holding institution named) and had the November 2023 site visit "find the tower still intact" (the register entry is just "Site Visit - 11/25/23", with no stated outcome). Both fixed to state only what the sources say.
